# hivelocity_contact (Resource)

Manages an additional contact (user) on your account. Grant it permissions with `hivelocity_contact_permissions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_contact" "oncall" {
  full_name   = "On-call Engineer"
  email       = "oncall@example.com"
  phone       = "+1 555 0100"
  description = "Shared on-call login"
  password    = var.oncall_password
}

variable "oncall_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address, used as the login.
- `full_name` (String) Full name of the contact.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the contact can log in. Defaults to true.
- `current_password` (String, Sensitive) Current password, required only when changing `password` of an existing contact.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the contact's role.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password. Only used on creation; later changes are applied through the contact password endpoint and require `current_password`.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (Number) Owning client ID.
- `contact_id` (Number) Unique ID of the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_client` (Boolean) True for the primary account contact.
- `referral_code` (String) Referral code of the contact.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the contact ID
terraform import hivelocity_contact.oncall 777
```
